props.heading: I design & develop digital experiences that make an impact

props.label: About Me
props.heading: Building digital products from concept to launch
props.body:
I'm a full-stack designer and developer with over six years of experience helping startups and businesses turn ideas into polished digital products. My approach is design-led and user-focused — I believe great code alone doesn't make a great product.

I work across the entire stack, from wireframing and prototyping to front-end and back-end development, deployment, and performance optimisation. Every project starts with understanding the problem, not picking the tech stack.

When I'm not building, I write about design systems, accessibility, and the business of freelancing.

pillars.title: Design-Led
pillars.text: Every pixel has a purpose. I design before I build, and I test before I launch.

pillars.title: User-Focused
pillars.text: Accessibility and usability aren't afterthoughts — they're baked into every decision.

pillars.title: Performance-Minded
pillars.text: Fast load times, clean code, and Core Web Vitals that consistently score 90+.

items.q: What is your typical project timeline?
items.a: Most projects take 4–8 weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on scope. A simple landing page can ship in two weeks; a full web application with dashboards and integrations typically takes 8–12 weeks. I'll give you a clear timeline during the discovery call.

items.q: Do you work with startups on a tight budget?
items.a: Yes — I keep a few slots each quarter for early-stage startups at reduced rates, often with equity or deferred payment instead of the usual retainer. Mention it in your enquiry and I'll share what's available.

items.q: What technologies do you work with?
items.a: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and serverless (AWS Lambda / Vercel) on the backend. Figma for UI/UX and Framer for interactive prototypes. I also have experience with React Native and Expo for mobile.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Most clients move to a monthly retainer covering security updates, content changes, performance monitoring, and light feature work. Retainers start at ₹15,000/month for a simple site.
The scope document we sign upfront includes two rounds of revisions per deliverable. Additional rounds are billed hourly. This keeps the project moving while still giving you room to refine things.

items.q: Can you work with my existing team or agency?
items.a: Absolutely. I regularly collaborate with agencies as a design or development partner — white-label, embedded in their team Slack, or as a dedicated sprint resource. We'll structure it however works best.

notes: Built for a personal portfolio on the Midnight Ink dark theme. The hero overlay is bumped to 0.6 to keep text readable on dark backgrounds. Services use a 3-column card layout; gallery is a 3-column grid with lightbox. Stats use the card variant with the theme's primary background — a strong visual break on a dark page. Sections default to transparent and alternate with surface where the manifest defaults call for it (gallery, testimonials). Testimonials avoid invented company names; roles describe the project context instead. Privacy and Terms links are disabled (showLegal: false) since a personal portfolio does not need legal pages.
